title: ISO/TS 18409:2018 — Hydraulic fluid power — Hose and hose assemblies — Method of collecting a fluid sample for analyzing the cleanliness of a hose or hose assembly
version: ISO/TS 18409:2018, Edition 1; reviewed and confirmed in 2025
locator: Official abstract: two methods for collecting fluid samples to analyse solid particulate contamination in hydraulic hoses or hose assemblies within the specified inside-diameter and length range.
notes: Sampling method only; it does not specify an efficient cleaning process, a universal cleanliness target or suitability for liquid/grease contamination analysis. Verify dimensional scope and method conditions before use.
